decisions.title: Access tokens are signed with the HS256 algorithm using one shared secret key.
Every access token carries the fixed subject claim access.
Access tokens are HS256 JWTs that expire one week after issue.
The Authorization header must hold a prefix and a token separated by one space, and the prefix must equal the configured jwt_token_prefix.
The fancyhash package is not used for password hashing because of its licence.
Tokens travel only in the Authorization header and never in cookies.
Passwords are hashed with bcrypt through passlib CryptContext, with a per-user bcrypt salt prepended to the password.
Each user gets a random salt created with bcrypt.gensalt.
Sessions use one long-lived access token and the API has no refresh tokens.
Registering with a username or email that is already taken is answered with HTTP 400.
Password reset links stay valid for 30 minutes.
bcrypt keeps the default passlib work factor.
Request validation failures return HTTP 422 with an errors list of the validator's error objects.
Only the comment's author, matched by username, may delete a comment.
Only an article's author, matched by username, may modify the article.
Favoriting inserts a (user_id, article_id) row into a favorites join table and ignores duplicates.
HTTP errors are returned as JSON of the form {"errors": [detail]} with the exception status code.
Tags are stored as unique text rows in a tags table and linked to articles through an articles_to_tags join table.
Cross-origin calls are allowed from the origins in allowed_hosts, which default to every origin.
Creating a tag that already exists is ignored by the insert statement.
Creating an article whose generated slug already exists is refused with HTTP 400.
The article list defaults to 20 items per page.
PostgreSQL is the data store and MongoDB was not chosen.
The code talks to PostgreSQL through raw SQL files loaded by aiosql on the asyncpg driver, wrapped in repository classes.
Settings are pydantic BaseSettings classes chosen by the APP_ENV value and cached with lru_cache.
Favoriting an article sends no notification to its author.
Article slugs are generated from the title with the slugify library.
Deleted articles and comments are removed from the database, with no soft-delete flag.
Queries are hand-written SQL files, not generated by an ORM.
The database pool is fixed at 10 connections through min_connection_count and max_connection_count.
Article lists page with limit and offset query parameters, defaulting to limit 20 and offset 0.
Tests live in a top-level tests folder split into test_api, test_db, test_schemas and test_services, with shared fixtures in conftest.py.

data.title: Decision register: product decisions
data.description: Product and security decisions whose reasons are not in the code. Invented for this demo.

decisions.title: Sessions use one long-lived access token and the API has no refresh tokens.
decisions.rationale: Security review SR-2025-14 of the pilot found that a stored refresh token let a stolen browser profile keep access for months. The team chose a one-week access token and no refresh token, so a stolen token expires on its own. Invented for this demo.
alternatives_considered: short access token with a refresh token

inspection.condition: Confirm that the code and the configuration still follow the decision: Sessions use one long-lived access token and the API has no refresh tokens.

decisions.title: Deleted articles and comments are removed from the database, with no soft-delete flag.
decisions.rationale: Legal review LR-77 requires that content its author deleted is gone from live storage within 24 hours. A deleted_at column was rejected because the rows would stay in the table. Invented for this demo.
alternatives_considered: soft delete with a deleted_at column

inspection.condition: Confirm that the code and the configuration still follow the decision: Deleted articles and comments are removed from the database, with no soft-delete flag.

decisions.title: Password reset links stay valid for 30 minutes.
decisions.rationale: Support tickets showed that users open a reset mail within 10 minutes. A link that lives 30 minutes covers slow mail delivery without leaving a long-lived link in an inbox. Invented for this demo.

inspection.condition: Confirm that the code and the configuration still follow the decision: Password reset links stay valid for 30 minutes.

decisions.title: The fancyhash package is not used for password hashing because of its licence.
decisions.rationale: The licence of fancyhash has a network-use clause that is not compatible with distributing the API. Passlib with bcrypt was kept. Invented for this demo.

inspection.condition: Confirm that the code and the configuration still follow the decision: The fancyhash package is not used for password hashing because of its licence.

decisions.title: bcrypt keeps the default passlib work factor.
decisions.rationale: Load test LT-9 put the login endpoint at a p95 of 240 ms with the default factor. One step higher pushed it past the 300 ms login budget. Invented for this demo.

inspection.condition: Confirm that the code and the configuration still follow the decision: bcrypt keeps the default passlib work factor.

decisions.title: The article list defaults to 20 items per page.
decisions.rationale: Design review DR-31 found that the mobile list screen fits 20 rows without scrolling. Invented for this demo.

inspection.condition: Confirm that the code and the configuration still follow the decision: The article list defaults to 20 items per page.

decisions.title: Favoriting an article sends no notification to its author.
decisions.rationale: Product decision PD-8 puts all notifications out of scope until the 2027 roadmap. Invented for this demo.
alternatives_considered: notify the author on every favorite

inspection.condition: Confirm that the code and the configuration still follow the decision: Favoriting an article sends no notification to its author.

decisions.title: PostgreSQL is the data store and MongoDB was not chosen.
decisions.rationale: The data is relational, and the DBA team supports only PostgreSQL (ADR-3). Invented for this demo.

inspection.condition: Confirm that the code and the configuration still follow the decision: PostgreSQL is the data store and MongoDB was not chosen.

decisions.title: Queries are hand-written SQL files, not generated by an ORM.
decisions.rationale: The DBA team reviews every query. A SQL file can be reviewed in a pull request and ORM output cannot (ADR-4). Invented for this demo.

inspection.condition: Confirm that the code and the configuration still follow the decision: Queries are hand-written SQL files, not generated by an ORM.

decisions.title: Tokens travel only in the Authorization header and never in cookies.
decisions.rationale: Cookie transport would need CSRF protection that this API does not have (ADR-5). Invented for this demo.

inspection.condition: Confirm that the code and the configuration still follow the decision: Tokens travel only in the Authorization header and never in cookies.
